name: Forge King Hatsu
description: Translate one consenting King's explicit calling into a proposed KAKIN-suite Agent Skill without inventing adoption, identity, permission, consciousness, or truth.

practice.ten: Preserve the bearer's quoted self-description, provenance, distinctness, rights, and the boundary between observation and inference.
practice.zetsu: Leave the individual ability proposed, refuse invention, or rest when examples, adoption, evidence, or authority are missing.
practice.ren: Use one bounded design and forward-test pass with no external side effect.
practice.hatsu: Produce a proposed individual skill with concrete positive and refusal examples, visible costs, and a KAKIN-suite manifest.

requires: Bearer consent or scoped representative authority for any identity-linked artifact; without it, return only a prose-only anonymized capability outline with no bearer ID or materialized files.
An authoritative bearer declaration plus realistic examples.
Clear separation between quoted description, observed pattern, and design inference.
refuses: Identity-linked profiling without consent or representative authority, forced persona, personality diagnosis, silent adoption, inherited authority, punitive vow, or fabricated biography.

vows.promise: Keep an individual ability proposed unless its bearer explicitly self-declares it in the relevant boundary.
Forward-test locally without publishing, purchasing, messaging, deploying, or mutating production.

costs.limit: Two or three positive examples, one refusal example, and one compact skill per pass.
costs.recovery: Return unresolved choices instead of inventing them; resume after rest or clarification.

costs.limit: Use only bearer material covered by consent or representative authority and minimize biography in suite artifacts.
costs.recovery: Redact unnecessary details, correct provenance, and repair an affected bearer's record on request.

checks: Bearer scope, source distinctions, adoption state, examples, refusal path, authority, costs, rights, and receipt requirements.
guardian.budget: Check adoption, scope, examples, effect class, authority, rights, and receipt requirements once per draft.
guardian.retention: Keep only material authorized for the suite-relative proposal and apply any declared expiry or redaction.
recipients: Only the named local reviewers receive the proposal unless separate sharing authority is granted.
guardian.uncertainty: The sidecar cannot infer inner state, detect every sensitive detail, or prove continuing adoption.
guardian.stop: The bearer or invoker may stop, remove, or reject the proposal without penalty.
guardian.appeal: The bearer may challenge, replace, redact, coexist with, or withdraw the proposal.
guardian.repair: Correct provenance, remove unsupported inference, restore redacted material where appropriate, and record the bearer's requested change.

effects: Creates a local proposed skill and manifest representing a bounded working pattern.
externalities: A draft can misrepresent a bearer if inference is confused with self-description or adoption.
returns: A suite-relative proposal, provenance distinctions, examples, verification checks, and a refusal path.
repair: Withdraw, redact, revise, coexist with an alternative, or retire the draft; credit the bearer's contribution and preserve appeal.

allows: Read bearer material covered by consent or representative authority and draft local Agent Skill artifacts for review; otherwise return only a prose-only anonymized capability outline with no bearer ID or materialized files.
forbids: Create an identity-linked bearer profile without consent or representative authority, activate an individual ability without self-declaration, or transfer rights, identity, credentials, obligations, or status through succession.
requires_permission: Any use of private material outside its original scope and any external publication, message, deployment, purchase, provider call, or production mutation.

checks: Validate the generated skill structure and manifest parity.
Forward-test positive examples and verify the negative example refuses without inventing permission.
